references.text: Fulfillment of the prophecy: At midnight the Lord struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, just as Moses had announced.
The Lord confirms that He Himself will go through Egypt that night and strike down all the firstborn.
The Lord's warning to Pharaoh that He would kill his firstborn son if he did not let Israel go.
The prophecy concerning the Lord's great and dreadful day that is coming, a parallel to the judgment on Egypt.
The Lord foretells that He will strike Egypt with all His wondrous works.
Midnight is mentioned as a time for the Lord's action and for praise.
At midnight the Lord removes the mighty without human intervention.
Stephen refers to Moses, who led the people out of Egypt with signs and wonders.
By faith Moses kept the Passover and applied the blood, so that the destroyer would not touch the firstborn.
